title: CI Features Schema
description: Schema for .claude/metadata/ci-features.json — CI feature registry for /ci --list and /ci --add
CI features keyed by feature ID

tier.description: Feature tier (v1 = common, v2 = recommended, v3 = advanced)

detectionPatterns.description: Patterns for detecting if feature is already configured

removalPatterns.description: How ci-remove recognizes this feature's own job steps (#3045). Each entry is a case-insensitive regex tested against that one step field, never the serialized step — matching the whole step on a bare detection word deleted unrelated steps. A step feature without this field has no removable location, and ci-remove reports a failure rather than a removal.
